source.publication: 2025 Maryland Resident Booklet (State and Local Tax Forms and Instructions), Form 502
source.section: Form 502 Lines 1, 10a, 11, 15-21; Worksheet 13A line 3 specific instruction (PDF page 14: 'If your total Social Security ... is greater than the Maximum Pension Exclusion $41,200, the pension exclusion will be zero'); Schedule I (PDF page 22)

worked: Federal (given, not tested): federal AGI = private employer pension (you) 20,000.00 + interest 550.00 + taxable Social Security 12,192.50 = 32,742.50. Taxable Social Security 12,192.50 is the federal Social Security Benefits Worksheet amount on gross benefits 45,000.00 (given). Federal taxable income = 32,742.50 - standard deduction 15,750.00 - 1 x 2,000.00 additional for age 65 or older = 14,992.50 (federal senior deduction ignored). Form 502 Line 1 federal AGI 32,742.50; Lines 2-6 additions 0.00 (no non-Maryland municipal interest); Line 7 total 32,742.50. Worksheet 13A: You (age 72): line 1 qualifying pension 20,000.00; line 2 41,200.00; line 3 Social Security 45,000.00; line 4 tentative 41,200.00 - 45,000.00 = 0.00; line 5 smaller = 0.00. Line 10a = 0.00. Line 11 taxable Social Security in Line 1 = 12,192.50 (exempt in full). Line 14 two-income subtraction: 0.00 (not a joint return). Line 15 total subtractions = Line 10a 0.00 + Line 11 12,192.50 = 12,192.50. Line 16 Maryland AGI = 32,742.50 - 12,192.50 = 20,550.00. Line 17 standard deduction (Instruction 16, flat by filing status) = 3,350.00. Line 18 net income = 20,550.00 - 3,350.00 = 17,200.00. Line 19 exemptions: Chart 10A at federal AGI 32,742.50 (not over 100,000) gives 3,200.00 each x 1 (Box A) + 1,000.00 x 1 for age 65 or older (Box B, not reduced by the chart) = 4,200.00. Line 20 taxable net income = 17,200.00 - 4,200.00 = 13,000.00. Line 21 tax, Schedule I as numbers: 2.00% x 1,000.00 = 20.00 + 3.00% x 1,000.00 = 30.00 + 4.00% x 1,000.00 = 40.00 + 4.75% x 10,000.00 = 475.00; total 565.00. (The tax table row 13,000-13,050, PDF page 34, gives 566; expected keeps the formula figure.) Lines 22-26 credits: none modelled or claimed, 0.00; Maryland state tax 565.00. Local tax (Lines 28-33) out of scope; 2% capital gain tax (Line 21b) not charged (no gains, AGI under 350,000). Worksheet 13A line 3 instructions: Social Security over 41,200 makes the pension exclusion zero; Social Security counts in full whether or not it is federally taxable.
